host.name: PrivateVoting
host.description: PrivateVoting is a secure, auditable online voting platform for schools, colleges, housing societies, NGOs, and organizations across India. It provides end-to-end digital election management with anonymous ballots, role-based access, real-time results, and certified PDF reports.

entries.description: Full-featured digital election platform supporting school elections, college student council voting, housing society AGMs, board of directors voting, and organizational ballots. Includes voter verification, role-based admin controls, live monitoring, and certified results.
representativeQueries: secure online voting platform for schools
digital election software for housing societies
free online voting tool for colleges

entries.description: Detailed platform capabilities: multi-ballot event setup, candidate management with photo uploads, voter verification via email or unique token, polling officer delegation, IP restrictions, live turnout monitoring, automated result publication, and downloadable audit logs.
representativeQueries: what features does an online voting platform offer
how to manage election candidates digitally
voter verification methods for digital elections
election audit log and reporting tools

entries.description: Security architecture covering end-to-end ballot confidentiality, role-based access control (RBAC), IP range restrictions, encrypted vote counting, tamper-evident ballots, and full audit trail for election compliance.
representativeQueries: how secure is online voting software

entries.description: Pay-per-event credit-based pricing model. Buy voting credits as needed — one credit equals one voting post. Available packs: Starter (5 credits), Standard (15 credits), Governance (40 credits). All prices inclusive of GST. No monthly subscription required.
